title: Fine-Tuning Whisper for Inclusive Prosodic Stress Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the ASR model's transcription accuracy of prosodic stress across neurotypical and autistic (ASD) speakers, and fine-tuning the model to explicitly classify the speaker's neurotype based on brief speech samples.
Evaluating the ASR model's transcription accuracy of prosodic stress across male and female speakers, and fine-tuning the model to explicitly classify the speaker's gender from brief speech samples.
